methodology.finding: The fee double count biases the forward component (15 rubric points) against the active funds
methodology.evidence: em_bonds.py:388 computes net = gross - er - loss although SEC and trailing yields are already net of fees. Understatement = expense ratio: TGEIX 0.85, PYEMX 0.73, PCY 0.50, CEMB 0.50, HYEM 0.40, EMB 0.39, EBND 0.30, EMLC 0 (its yield to worst is gross). Forward rank changes: TGEIX 5->3, EBND above EMLC. The analyst flags the problem but does not correct it. It is partly offset by +0.17-0.23pt from monthly compounding of the yield in research.bonds.total_returns (unchanged-yield gross return minus quoted yield).

methodology.finding: The Mexico row of the country table is wrong: MX_10Y has 63 missing months, and country_returns (em_bonds.py:443) drops them, so each gap is treated as one month and its FX move is lost
methodology.evidence: MX USD CAGR since 2010: 7.18% as built vs 4.59% with gaps interpolated; OOS 12.58% vs 7.61%. The table shows MXN at +0.5%/yr, while MXN actually fell 2.1%/yr. The EMLC cross-check basket is barely affected (3.35% vs 3.37%).

methodology.finding: The Monte Carlo is not an independent second method
methodology.evidence: the median minus the yield estimate lies between -0.19 and +0.44pt for all eight funds (montecarlo._scale_to targets the yield estimate), so the 'consensus of at least two methods' (method s7) is in practice one method. The analyst says so; the rubric should say it too.

methodology.finding: The control rank test uses a composite that is half 2026 data and contains two mis-benchmarked IRs
methodology.evidence: em_bond_scored.csv ytm equals the 2026-11 em_bond_inputs.csv ytm for every fund. Spearman vs OOS Sharpe: 0.203 (p 0.42) as published; 0.172 (p 0.49) with corrected IRs; 0.162 (p 0.52) on returns only. Composite vs OOS IR: -0.04 published, -0.08 corrected. By method s7 the in-sample ranking therefore has no predictive value for IR, yet the verdicts lean on OOS IR.

methodology.finding: The rankings among the eight are not statistically separable
methodology.evidence: every |t(IR vs type benchmark)| is below 0.9, except EMB and EMLC against GUIDE_BENCH; DSR at most 0.071. Three non-shortlisted control funds beat every pick on OOS Sharpe (EEIIX 0.19, PEBIX 0.14, EMHY 0.134).

methodology.finding: The currency decomposition and the hedge result depend on an assumed basket
methodology.evidence: equal weight vs GBI-EM: FX -2.3% vs -3.4%, FX share 0.73 vs 0.52, hedged 0.4% vs 2.2% (the latter biased upward by unhedged TRY/BRL).

methodology.finding: Survivorship: the long list holds only funds alive in 2026 (404 tickers dropped, em_bonds_notes.md step 1); there is no dead-fund group for bonds
